_comment: Snapshot. Cloudflare ranges are copied from https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4 and /ips-v6 and MUST be refreshed with `iisguard update-rules` (M5). CloudFront and Azure Front Door lists are large and change often, so they are not hard-coded: fetch them from https://ip-ranges.amazonaws.com/ip-ranges.json (service CLOUDFRONT) and the Azure Service Tags file (AzureFrontDoor.Backend). Until then add your CDN ranges to the `cdn_ranges` config setting.
